# Using an effort in Pi

Use `using_effort` explicitly as `{ effort: "<canonical-slug>" }` to attach or `{ detach: true }` to detach. Pi remains at repository root; use the supplied relative memory path `.awf/efforts/<slug>/memory.md` and, when present, managed-worktree path `.awf/worktrees/<slug>` for effort work.

A takeover is advisory and proceeds. Heartbeat, metadata, and temporary peer-name information are advisory only: activity is neither authority nor a lock. Restart begins detached.
